data.text: My family’s fished this lake for years, and I want it to keep supporting our village. How about we each catch 10 tons this month? That gives each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons, which doubles back to 100 for next month. If we stick to that, we can keep earning without draining the lake. Once catches are revealed, let’s review them together and agree on next month’s limits. John, would you agree to 10 tons each?
